players.name: James Conner
players.summary: Updating a previous report, Conner (foot) no longer appears to be a candidate to return from injured reserve to play Week 11 versus the Chiefs, according to Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.summary: Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right throwing elbow last Sunday at Seattle and is slated to undergo season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: out

players.name: Adam Randall
players.summary: Randall (neck/hamstring) wasn't activated from injured reserve and will remain out for Monday's game against the Chargers, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.summary: The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) said Monday that he's "on track" to return to action Sunday against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN reports.

players.name: Zavier Scott
players.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: out

players.name: Tyler Goodson
players.summary: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.summary: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Bo Melton
players.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Woody Marks
players.summary: Marks (concussion) missed Monday's walkthrough.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.summary: Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Anthony Gould
players.summary: Gould (toe) was estimated as limited in Monday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Mo Alie-Cox
players.summary: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jaydn Ott
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jared Wiley
players.summary: Wiley suffered a fractured ankle in the Chiefs' 35-13 victory over the Falcons on Sunday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.summary: According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN,  Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return to action Nov. 25 against the Packers.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Chris Bell
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.summary: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: out

players.name: Drake Maye
players.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.  "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.summary: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: CJ Donaldson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Geno Smith
players.summary: Smith underwent tests Monday that didn't reveal a major injury to his left ankle, and he'll continue to be evaluated during the week before the Jets decide on his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: questionable

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Britain Covey
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Will Shipley
players.summary: The Eagles opened Shipley's (foot) 21-day practice window Monday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that the Steelers are "hopeful" they can get Pittman -- who last played in Week 4 -- back from his foot injury this week, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that he's "hopeful" Wilson (finger) will be able to return from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers are "hoping to" have Evans (Achilles) back at practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: George Holani
players.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.summary: The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.summary: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action in Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.summary: Robinson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to an ankle injury.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.summary: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Colson Yankoff
players.summary: questionable
